rationale: Fixed impotent integral and added adaptive feedforward. Old ki*integ max was 0.006*0.30=0.0018 so steady error could not be removed when gain halved (stuck at u~0.46,y~0.39). New uses ki=0.025 with contribution limits +-0.35 (max 0.35) plus slow gain estimator Kest: yf tau12s, ys/uf tau35s, settled gate |yf-ys|<0.02, uf in 0.15-0.90, yf>y0+0.03, t>60s, then Kest+=(Kraw-Kest)*dt/(50+dt) with Kraw=(ys-y0)/uf clamped 0.35-1.30, and uff=(target-y0)/Kest clamped 0-0.85. Kept safety caps at 0.75/0.80 and rate limit 0.10*dt+0.02 and outlier-rejecting filter.
